title: Eddoboozi mu Musenyu ogw’Edda
intro: Mu babaka ba Allah abaasooka, waliwo omu erinnya lye eyaka mu bufunze naye nga lirina amakulu mu Quran. Ono ssekinnoomu yawangaala dda nga bannabbi abakulu bangi tebannasindikibwa, era yali amanyiddwa olw’amazima agatakyukakyuka n’obugumiikiriza. Emboozi yaabwe nnyimpi naye omusika gwabwe gugumira mu likodi ey’olubeerera. Omwoyo guno ogw’ekitiibwa y’ani?
clues: Nze omu ku babaka abaasooka, ayogerwako mu bufunze naye nga n’amakulu mu Quran.
Empisa zange zaali zitegeezebwa okwewaayo okutakyukakyuka eri amazima.
Njjukirwa mu kitabo kya Allah mu abo abaali banywevu era abagumiikiriza.
Aya ennyimpi ntono zokka mu Quran ze zinyumya emboozi yange.
Allah yanzisaamu ekitiibwa mu ngeri ey’enjawulo eyange, etagabana na bannabbi balala.
Nakuzibwa ku siteegi eya waggulu, ekitiibwa ekimu mu Quran.

trial.label: Okunnyonnyola Akaseera
options: Nakuzibwa ku siteegi eya waggulu Allah
Nnazimba eryato eddene okutaasa abantu bange
trial.answer: Nakuzibwa ku siteegi eya waggulu Allah

outcome.label: Ekitiibwa eky’Obwakatonda
options: Siteegi eya waggulu obutafaananako ndala yonna
outcome.answer: Siteegi eya waggulu obutafaananako ndala yonna

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
